programs.title: Drive
programs.desc: This drive heads to stunning South Australia and the popular remote holiday destination of Kangaroo Island with the equally impressive Kia Niro EV, complete with its own barista.

programs.title: Tanked
programs.desc: The Las Vegas Museum of Natural History asks ATM to create an aquarium in the shape of a carousel, but instead of horses this carousel will be filled with seahorses.

programs.title: Salvage Hunters
programs.desc: Drew Pritchard and sidekick Tee are on a buying trip in Germany. They trade with Counts and Barons and meet characters as quirky as the antiques they're potentially selling.

programs.title: How It's Made
programs.sub_title: Motion Sensors; Belt Loaders; Pheasant Breeding; Diving Helmets
programs.desc: Discover how combination squares and ball valves are constructed. Also, explore how shrimp are farmed and see how string trimmers are made.

programs.title: How It's Made
programs.sub_title: Rawhide Lampshades; Chocolate Chip Cookies; MRI Scanners
programs.desc: A look at how a factory takes rawhide and produces lampshades; a machine bakes chocolate chip cookies in a large over for mass production; a look at how a factory builds MRI scanners for medical professionals such as neurologists.

programs.title: Wheeler Dealers
programs.desc: Elvis convinces Mike to buy a bargain VW Golf convertible. But its bright colour is divisive, and it's also rusty, filthy with a busted convertible roof!
